## Set scripts directory
```{r, echo=FALSE}
if ("Scripts" %in% unlist(strsplit(normalizePath("."), "/"))) {
  scripts_directory = paste(unlist(strsplit(normalizePath("."), "/"))[1:which(unlist(strsplit(normalizePath("."), "/"))=="Scripts")],collapse="/")
} else {
  print("Select any file within Scripts to set up the path")
  temp = file.choose()
  scripts_directory = paste(unlist(strsplit(temp, "/"))[1:which(unlist(strsplit(temp, "/"))=="Scripts")],collapse="/")
}
```

## Load analysis functions
```{r}
source(file.path(scripts_directory, 
                 "Utility Scripts",
                 "geo_lifedata.r"))

source(file.path(scripts_directory, 
                 "Utility Scripts",
                 "geo_analysis2.r"))

#error goes away if I run "geo_lifedata.r" first

```

## Load EMA, and covariate data
```{r}
EMA_Baseline_Covariates_Distinct = load_ema_with_covs(Type="Baseline",
                                                      ema_variables = c("day", "daily_average_crave", "daily_cigs", "daily_stress", "microagg_day", "microagg_count", "daily_average_neg", "daily_average_pos", "stress_day", "stress_events_interpersonal tensions", "stress_events_health/accident", "stress_events_events that happened to others", "stress_events_being evaluated", "stress_events_work/education", "stress_events_home", "stress_events_other", "stress_events_none of the above", "microagg_Because of my education",  "microagg_Because of my gender", "microagg_Because of my income level", "microagg_Because of my race", "microagg_Because of my sexual orientation", "microagg_Because of another personal attribute", "microagg_Because I am a smoker"), 
#Look up variable descriptions in the geo_lifedata.R 
                        redcap_variables = c("pid","age","gender","ethnicity","race","sexuality")) %>% #any notes on sexuality labels?
  add_descriptives(vars="platformType") %>% 
  distinct()
```

# Analyses 

## Calculate within and between exposure measures
```{r, echo=FALSE}
All_data = All_data %>%
  split_within_between(c("daily_exposures_500ft_100ft",
                          "daily_exposures_1000ft_100ft",
                         "daily_average_neg",
                          "daily_stress",
                          "microagg_day",
                          "stress_day"))

All_data = All_data %>%
  split_within_between(c("daily_cigs",
                         "daily_average_crave"))

```

```{r}
All_data = All_data %>%
  split_within_between(c("stress_events_interpersonal tensions", 
      "stress_events_health/accident", 
      "stress_events_events that happened to others", 
      "stress_events_being evaluated", 
      "stress_events_work/education", 
      "stress_events_home",

      "stress_events_none of the above", 
      "microagg_Because of my education",  
      "microagg_Because of my gender", 
      "microagg_Because of my income level", 
      "microagg_Because of my race", 
      "microagg_Because of my sexual orientation", 
      "microagg_Because of another personal attribute", 
      "microagg_Because I am a smoker")) 
```

## Define models
```{r}
neg_mood_model = create_model_function(
  "daily_average_neg_wn + daily_average_neg_bw + day + (1|pid)"
  )

stress_model = create_model_function(
  "daily_stress_wn + daily_stress_bw + day + (1|pid)"
  )

discrim_model1 = create_model_function(
  "microagg_day + microagg_day_bw + day + (1|pid)"
  )

discrim_model2 = create_model_function(
  "microagg_day_wn + microagg_day_bw + day + (1|pid)"
  )

discrimANDexposure_model_500ft = create_model_function(
  "microagg_day + microagg_day_bw + daily_exposures_500ft_100ft_wn + daily_exposures_500ft_100ft_bw + microagg_day*daily_exposures_500ft_100ft_wn + day + (1|pid)"
  )

discrim2ANDexposure_model_500ft = create_model_function(
  "microagg_day_wn + microagg_day_bw + daily_exposures_500ft_100ft_wn + daily_exposures_500ft_100ft_bw + microagg_day_wn*daily_exposures_500ft_100ft_wn + day + (1|pid)"
  )

discrimANDexposure_model_1000ft = create_model_function(
  "microagg_day + microagg_day_bw + daily_exposures_1000ft_100ft_wn + daily_exposures_1000ft_100ft_bw + microagg_day*daily_exposures_1000ft_100ft_wn + day + (1|pid)"
  )

discrim2ANDexposure_model_1000ft = create_model_function(
  "microagg_day_wn + microagg_day_bw + daily_exposures_1000ft_100ft_wn + daily_exposures_1000ft_100ft_bw + microagg_day_wn*daily_exposures_500ft_100ft_wn + day + (1|pid)"
  )

discrimANDstress_model = create_model_function(
  "microagg_day + microagg_day_bw + stress_day + stress_day_bw + day + (1|pid)"
  )

allstress_model = create_model_function(
  "stress_day + stress_day_bw + day + (1|pid)"
  )

interpersonalstress_model = create_model_function(
  "`stress_events_interpersonal tensions` + `stress_events_interpersonal tensions_bw` + day + (1|pid)"
  )

healthstress_model = create_model_function(
  "`stress_events_health/accident` + `stress_events_health/accident_bw` + day + (1|pid)"
  )

otherpeoplestress_model = create_model_function(
  "`stress_events_events that happened to others` + `stress_events_events that happened to others_bw` + day + (1|pid)"
  )

evalstress_model = create_model_function(
  "`stress_events_being evaluated` + `stress_events_being evaluated_bw` + day + (1|pid)"
  )

edustress_model = create_model_function(
  "`stress_events_work/education` + `stress_events_work/education_bw` + day + (1|pid)"
  )

homestress_model = create_model_function(
  "`stress_events_home` + `stress_events_home_bw` + day + (1|pid)"
  )

otherstress_model = create_model_function(
  "`stress_events_other` + `stress_events_other_bw` + day + (1|pid)"
  )

interpersonalstress_model = create_model_function(
  "`stress_events_interpersonal tensions` + `stress_events_interpersonal tensions` + day + (1|pid)"
  )

interpersonalstress_model = create_model_function(
  "`stress_events_interpersonal tensions` + `stress_events_interpersonal tensions` + day + (1|pid)"
  )
```

# Hypotheses & Research Questions
(switched all models from lme to lmer becuase lme was getting errors when I tried adding random effects)


```{r}
stress <- stress_model(All_data, "daily_cigs")
summary(stress)

stress <- stress_model(All_data, "daily_average_crave")
summary(stress)


mood <- neg_mood_model(All_data, "daily_cigs")
summary(mood)

mood <- neg_mood_model(All_data, "daily_average_crave")
summary(mood)




combo_model = create_model_function(
  "daily_exposures_500ft_100ft_wn + daily_exposures_500ft_100ft_bw + daily_stress_wn + daily_stress_bw + day + (1|pid)"
  )

combo <- combo_model(All_data, "daily_average_crave")
summary(combo)
r2_nakagawa(combo)

library(lmerTest) # for model fitting
library(performance) # for Nakagawa conditional/marginal R2
r2_nakagawa(combo)


combo_smoke_model = create_model_function(
  "daily_exposures_500ft_100ft_wn + daily_exposures_500ft_100ft_bw + daily_stress_wn + daily_stress_bw + day + (1|pid)"
  )

combo_smoke <- combo_smoke_model(All_data, "daily_cigs")
summary(combo_smoke)

r2_nakagawa(combo_smoke)
```

##Stress as an outcome

### Hypothesis 1:
On days when smokers experience interpersonal discrimination, they will feel more negative than they will on days when they don’t experience interpersonal discrimination.

#### Negative mood as an outcome (H1)
```{r}
lme_neg_discrim1 <- discrim_model1(All_data, "daily_average_neg")
summary(lme_neg_discrim1)

lme_neg_discrim2 <- discrim_model2(All_data, "daily_average_neg")
summary(lme_neg_discrim2)
```
##### Plot/viz (haven't checked/updated)
```{r}
lme_neg_discrim1_plot <- discrim_model1(All_dataNA, "daily_average_neg")
summary(lme_neg_discrim1_plot)
```

```{r}
All_dataNA$predH1b <- predict(lme_neg_discrim1_plot)

ggplot(data=All_dataNA, aes(x=microagg_day, y=predH1b, group=factor(pid), color="gray"), legend=FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(method=lm, se=FALSE, fullrange=FALSE, lty=1, linewidth=.5, color="gray40") +
  geom_smooth(aes(group=1), method=lm, se=FALSE, fullrange=FALSE, lty=1, size=2, color="red4") +
  xlab("Interpersonal Discrimination") + ylab("Negative Mood") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size=18),
        axis.text=element_text(size=14),
        plot.title=element_text(size=18, hjust=.5)) +
  ggtitle("Interpersonal discrimination makes people feel more negative")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=All_dataNA, aes(x=microagg_day, y=predH1b), legend=FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(method=lm, se=TRUE, fullrange=FALSE, lty=1, linewidth=.5, fill="pink", color="black") +
  geom_smooth(aes(group=1), method=lm, se=TRUE, fullrange=FALSE, lty=1, size=2, color="red4", fill="red4", alpha=0.2) +
  xlab("Interpersonal Discrimination") + ylab("Negative Mood") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size=18),
        axis.text=element_text(size=14),
        plot.title=element_text(size=18, hjust=.5)) +
  ggtitle("Interpersonal discrimination was associated \n with feeling more negative")
```

### H3: On days when smokers experience interpersonal discrimination, they will crave cigarettes more than they will on days when they don’t experience interpersonal discrimination 
#### Craving as an outcome
```{r}
lme_craving_discrim1 <- discrim_model1(All_data, "daily_average_crave")
summary(lme_craving_discrim1)

lme_craving_discrim2 <- discrim_model2(All_data, "daily_average_crave")
summary(lme_craving_discrim2)

# Use the model with covariates
lme_craving_discrim1_cov = 
  discrim_model1(
    data = All_data, 
    dv = "daily_average_crave",
    covs ="age") #can add more if I think I should 
summary(lme_craving_discrim1_cov)
```

(non-hypotheses)
```{r}
lme_craving_discrim1ANDexpo500 <- discrimANDexposure_model_500ft(All_data, "daily_average_crave")
summary(lme_craving_discrim1ANDexpo500)
```

```{r}
lme_craving_discrim2ANDexpo500 <- discrim2ANDexposure_model_500ft(All_data, "daily_average_crave")
summary(lme_craving_discrim2ANDexpo500)
```

```{r}
lme_craving_discrim1ANDexpo1000 <- discrimANDexposure_model_1000ft(All_data, "daily_average_crave")
summary(lme_craving_discrim1ANDexpo1000)
```

### Research Question 2: Will participants crave cigarettes more on days they experience interpersonal discrimination above and beyond experiencing other types of stressors that day? 
```{r}
lme_craving_discrimANDstress <- discrimANDstress_model(All_data, "daily_average_crave")
summary(lme_craving_discrimANDstress)
```

####Plot/Viz

### Research Question 3: Which groups of smokers report experiencinge more interpersonal discrimination in their daily lives? 
```{r}

```
